- Total revenue was £135.3k TW versus £159.1k LW, a WoW change of -15.0%.
- Total revenue TW of £135.3k compares with £85.7k LY, a YoY change of +57.9%.
- TOTAL volume TW was 46,342 units across 4,027 orders.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS led TW at £5,701.16, a 4.2% share of total revenue, while RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT took £5,084.81 (3.8% share) and CHILLI LIGHTS £4,960.25 (3.7% share).
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER posted £3,543.60 TW and PAPER CHAIN KIT VINTAGE CHRISTMAS £3,034.33 TW, with the top five products at 16.5% of TOTAL revenue TW.
- Largest WoW gains came from CHILLI LIGHTS at +£2,653.24, CHILDRENS CUTLERY POLKADOT PINK at +£1,579.72 and SPOTTY BUNTING at +£1,348.06.
- Largest WoW declines came from RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT at -£5,602.88, PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS at -£3,783.99 and JUMBO BAG 50'S CHRISTMAS at -£2,568.26.
- On percentage terms WoW, SET/3 VANILLA SCENTED CANDLE IN BOX rose 1,256.0% and COLOURED GLASS STAR T-LIGHT HOLDER rose 1,050.4%, while 3 HEARTS HANGING DECORATION RUSTIC fell 73.8%.
